lines.text: How's the shoulder been since last time?
Since last time it still catches when I reach up into the cupboard.
Have you had any treatment elsewhere?
I had some massage at the gym spa, it helped for a day.
Sorry to barge in. Your next one's phoned to say she's running twenty minutes late.
Scribe, leave that last bit out of the note.
Right, let me have a look. Arms up for me. There's a painful arc between about eighty and a hundred and twenty degrees.
I'm going to take you through some needling today if you're happy, then we'll do the band work.
Yes, go ahead with the needles.
Do the band pulls against the door handle, three sets of fifteen, every other day, stopping if the pain goes above four out of ten.
